_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With score movement in only 3% of 12h windows and no breaker visible (ETF inflows absent, VIX/DXY thresholds unbreached), HOLD is the statistically honest default — a directional call here requires seeing the catalyst and neither brain has named one that's live.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegal jump from Denial) while Narrative implies an imminent bottoming resolution higher; consensus overrides both to HOLD at Denial pending a verified breaker
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>20) with funding below 0.01%, signaling institutional re-entry without retail FOMO — would validate Denial→Anxiety or Disbelief transition
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX closes above 22 with DXY above 103 and BTC funding spikes above 0.015% — macro stress plus leveraged longs would break the Denial floor toward Panic
